To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the theories about sport humanity should be based on the philosophic system,nation culture and cultural confidence.
sport cultural phenomena cannot be explained in terms of random creation or sample references.

The lack of philosophic thought and theories will result the deviation of ultimate values from their standard; the lack of traditional culture and symbols will result in the disappearing of national symbols and the lack of research methods will result in the slow down of disciplinary development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of theories on sport humanity from an anthropological perspective.
the development of theories on sport humanities from the perspective of anthropological theories.
the relationship between sport and culture, and the development of sport cultural theories.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the researches on theories of sport humanity from the perspectives of anthropology are the most important and the most effective way of developing theories about sport humanity.
sport humanity theories must be developed from a comprehensive and profound perspective of anthropology.
the theories of sports humanity should be developed based on the philosophic system of anthropology,the cultural consciousness of traditional culture,and the cultural confidence of national culture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the development of theories in sport humanities should be based on anthropological views and researches,and should be combined with the development of other humanities.
we need to establish our own theories about sport humanity based on the development of our own culture and the development of sport culture in the world.
sport humanity is a branch of humanities and that it should be developed based on anthropology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sport cultural researches should not be limited to the study of the physical and physiological aspects of sport,but should be extended to a more holistic view of the cultural aspects of sport.
sport humanity is a cultural phenomenon,so we must take cultural factors as the basis for researches and develop a system of theories based on cultural anthropology.
sport cultural phenomena have a certain degree of universality,and that sport humanity is the core of sports culture.
